hints.title: Identifying First Discrepancy
hints.text: Iterate through the arrays until finding the first discrepancy between sensor1 and sensor2.

hints.title: Last Element Boundary Check
hints.text: if the mismatch occurs at the last element, the dropped element occurred at the end and we cannot determine which sensor is defective.

hints.title: Comparing Shifted Suffixes
hints.text: compare the remaining suffix of sensor1 with the shifted suffix of sensor2, and vice versa.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass finds first divergence, then suffix comparisons check shift hypotheses.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all possible single-deletion arrays is overly complex for a single-mismatch check.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two pointers traverse the array in single-pass O(N) time with O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should find the first diverging index and check both shift hypotheses.
